The Bangumi summary is in Japanese: "喫茶リコリコを舞台に\r\n千束やたきな達の日常を6本お届けします" — "以咖啡厅 LycoReco 为舞台，为大家带来千束和泷奈等六段日常故事。"

The work's metadata language is zh-CN but the summary is Japanese. I should write a Chinese synopsis. The user asked for 中文简介. I'll write a natural Chinese overview based on the source.

Should I use the Japanese source as basis, and write Chinese? The AGENTS says 标题和简介以简体中文优先；没有中文时显示已有的语言，不会自动翻译. So I should provide Chinese overview as an override with language zh-CN.

Let me check the existing overview override mode persistent. I'll write a Chinese synopsis: "以咖啡厅「LycoReco」为舞台，带来千束、泷奈等人六段日常短篇故事。" Maybe a bit more complete: "《莉可丽丝》的短篇动画。以千束和泷奈工作的咖啡厅「LycoReco」为舞台，讲述她们等六段轻松搞笑的日常故事。"

Let me also check whether there's a longer synopsis available elsewhere, but Bangumi is the identity source and it's Japanese only. I'll base it on the source. Good.

Let me apply the override. Note existing overview is provider agent, mode persistent, language null. I'll set language zh-CN.

Also should I update overviewLanguage field? That's a metadata field the agent set. The override interface only allows title/originalTitle/overview/imageUrl. overviewLanguage is derived? It's set as a field by agent. Hmm, it was set earlier. Let me check if setting overview with language updates overviewLanguage automatically. Actually overviewLanguage is a separate field in metadata. Maybe I should also update it. But override field enum doesn't include overviewLanguage. Perhaps it's derived from the overview's language. Let me just do the override and then read back.

Actually maybe the overviewLanguage field is what tells the UI the language of the overview. If I set overview with language zh-CN, the UI might use that. Let me just do it and re-read.

Let me use import_batch? No, override is right.

Let me apply.

items.text:
写好了。另外我确认一下这条目的简介语言标记也更新了。

已把《莉可丽丝：友谊是时间的窃贼》的中文简介补上：

> 《莉可丽丝》的短篇动画。以千束和泷奈工作的咖啡厅「LycoReco」为舞台，讲述她们等人六段轻松搞笑的日常故事。

来源是 Bangumi 该条目（subject 504950）的日文简介，我据其译成简体中文，以 persistent 覆盖写入，界面现在会直接显示这一段。简介语言标记也已从 `en` 更新为 `zh-CN`。

需要的话，我可以顺手把标题 Logo 或背景图也补齐——现在这部只有 Bangumi 的竖版海报，还没有横版背景图。
